extraction.Name: Cecelia Guittar Rappuie
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record in Pawnee County, Oklahoma, by allottee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land has not been sold. No mortgage.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Shares in Pawnee Annuity. Land leased for $360.00 per annum, but a good part of same used for repairs to improvements.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered Feb. 4, 1918, Agency office. Was receipted for: yes. Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes: no. Patent has not been cancelled; no mortgage issued; date of redemption expired: none. Allottee is in poor health. Has two small houses in Pawnee, Oklahoma. Two boys dependent upon her who work a part of the time but have no income of any sort. The allottee feels that the Government made a mistake in granting her a patent on this land, which has worked a hardship on her in keeping the taxes paid up and improvements repaired. No inherited land. Notarized December 6, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.
